--!strict
-- CurrencyManager — Server-authoritative multi-currency system
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
export type CurrencyDef = { id: string, name: string, max: number, starting: number }
export type CurrencySystem = {
    Get: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player, currencyId: string) -> number,
    Add: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    Spend: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    CanAfford: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    Set: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    GetAll: (self: CurrencySystem, player: Player) -> {[string]: number},
    Destroy: (self: CurrencySystem) -> (),
}
type Internal = CurrencySystem & { _defs: {[string]: CurrencyDef}, _data: {[Player]: {[string]: number}}, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Get(self: Internal, player: Player, currencyId: string): number
    local pd = self._data[player]; return pd and pd[currencyId] or 0
end
function Impl.Add(self: Internal, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number): boolean
    if amount <= 0 then return false end
    local def = self._defs[currencyId]; if not def then return false end
    if not self._data[player] then self._data[player] = {} end
    local cur = self._data[player][currencyId] or 0
    if cur + amount > def.max then return false end
    self._data[player][currencyId] = cur + amount; return true
end
function Impl.Spend(self: Internal, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number): boolean
    if amount <= 0 then return false end
    local cur = self:Get(player, currencyId)
    if cur < amount then return false end
    self._data[player][currencyId] = cur - amount; return true
end
function Impl.CanAfford(self: Internal, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number): boolean
    return self:Get(player, currencyId) >= amount
end
function Impl.Set(self: Internal, player: Player, currencyId: string, amount: number): boolean
    local def = self._defs[currencyId]; if not def then return false end
    if amount < 0 or amount > def.max then return false end
    if not self._data[player] then self._data[player] = {} end
    self._data[player][currencyId] = amount; return true
end
function Impl.GetAll(self: Internal, player: Player): {[string]: number}
    local r: {[string]: number} = {}; local pd = self._data[player]
    if pd then for k, v in pd do r[k] = v end end; return r
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data)
end
local CurrencySystem = {}
function CurrencySystem.new(defs: {[string]: CurrencyDef}): CurrencySystem
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _defs = defs, _data = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        self._data[p] = {}; for id, def in defs do self._data[p][id] = def.starting end
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._data[p] = nil end))
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        self._data[p] = {}; for id, def in defs do self._data[p][id] = def.starting end
    end
    return self :: CurrencySystem
end
return CurrencySystem

--!strict
-- EventBus — Global publish/subscribe message bus
export type Subscription = { Unsubscribe: (self: Subscription) -> () }
export type EventBus = {
    Publish: (self: EventBus, topic: string, ...any) -> (),
    Subscribe: (self: EventBus, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()) -> Subscription,
    Once: (self: EventBus, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()) -> Subscription,
    GetSubscriberCount: (self: EventBus, topic: string) -> number,
    Clear: (self: EventBus, topic: string?) -> (),
}
type Internal = EventBus & { _topics: {[string]: {[({...any}) -> ()]: boolean}} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Publish(self: Internal, topic: string, ...: any)
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return end
    for cb in subs do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end
function Impl.Subscribe(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    if not self._topics[topic] then self._topics[topic] = {} end
    self._topics[topic][callback] = true
    return { Unsubscribe = function(_self: Subscription)
        local t = self._topics[topic]; if t then t[callback] = nil end
    end }
end
function Impl.Once(self: Internal, topic: string, callback: (...any) -> ()): Subscription
    local sub: Subscription
    local function wrapper(...: any)
        sub:Unsubscribe(); callback(...)
    end
    sub = self:Subscribe(topic, wrapper)
    return sub
end
function Impl.GetSubscriberCount(self: Internal, topic: string): number
    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return 0 end
    local n = 0; for _ in subs do n += 1 end; return n
end
function Impl.Clear(self: Internal, topic: string?)
    if topic then self._topics[topic] = nil else table.clear(self._topics) end
end
local EventBus = {}
function EventBus.new(): EventBus
    return setmetatable({ _topics = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return EventBus

    Spawn: (self: DamageNumberSystem, position: Vector3, text: string, config: DamageNumberConfig?) -> (),

}

local DEFAULT_CONFIG: DamageNumberConfig = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), fontSize = 24, duration = 1, riseDistance = 3 }
function Impl.Spawn(self: Internal, position: Vector3, text: string, config: DamageNumberConfig?)
    local cfg = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    local billboard: BillboardGui
    if #self._pool > 0 then
        billboard = table.remove(self._pool)
    else
        billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 40)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Adornee = nil
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name = "Label"
        label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
        label.Parent = billboard
    end
    billboard.Adornee = nil
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.zero
    billboard.Parent = self._parent
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.zero
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    part.Parent = workspace
    billboard.Adornee = part
    local label = billboard:FindFirstChild("Label")
    if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
        label.Text = text
        label.TextColor3 = cfg.color
        label.TextSize = cfg.fontSize
    end
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(cfg.duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(billboard, tweenInfo, { StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, cfg.riseDistance, 0) })
    task.delay(cfg.duration, function()
        tween:Cancel()
        billboard.Parent = nil
        part:Destroy()
        if #self._pool < 50 then table.insert(self._pool, billboard) else billboard:Destroy() end
    end)
    tween:Play()
end

    for _, bb in self._pool do bb:Destroy() end; table.clear(self._pool)
end

    return setmetatable({ _pool = {}, _parent = parent }, Impl) :: any
end

--!strict
-- DamageNumberDisplay — Floating damage numbers with pooling
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
export type DamageNumberConfig = { color: Color3, fontSize: number, duration: number, riseDistance: number }
export type DamageNumberSystem = {
    Spawn: (self: DamageNumberSystem, position: Vector3, text: string, config: DamageNumberConfig?) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: DamageNumberSystem) -> (),
}
type Internal = DamageNumberSystem & { _gui: ScreenGui, _billboardTemplate: BillboardGui, _pool: {BillboardGui}, _parent: Instance }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
local DEFAULT_CONFIG: DamageNumberConfig = { color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 80, 80), fontSize = 24, duration = 1, riseDistance = 3 }
function Impl.Spawn(self: Internal, position: Vector3, text: string, config: DamageNumberConfig?)
    local cfg = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    local billboard: BillboardGui
    if #self._pool > 0 then
        billboard = table.remove(self._pool)
    else
        billboard = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
        billboard.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(100, 40)
        billboard.AlwaysOnTop = true
        billboard.Adornee = nil
        local label = Instance.new("TextLabel")
        label.Name = "Label"
        label.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
        label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
        label.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
        label.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.5
        label.Parent = billboard
    end
    billboard.Adornee = nil
    billboard.StudsOffset = Vector3.zero
    billboard.Parent = self._parent
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Size = Vector3.zero
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.Transparency = 1
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    part.Parent = workspace
    billboard.Adornee = part
    local label = billboard:FindFirstChild("Label")
    if label and label:IsA("TextLabel") then
        label.Text = text
        label.TextColor3 = cfg.color
        label.TextSize = cfg.fontSize
    end
    local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(cfg.duration, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
    local tween = TweenService:Create(billboard, tweenInfo, { StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, cfg.riseDistance, 0) })
    task.delay(cfg.duration, function()
        tween:Cancel()
        billboard.Parent = nil
        part:Destroy()
        if #self._pool < 50 then table.insert(self._pool, billboard) else billboard:Destroy() end
    end)
    tween:Play()
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, bb in self._pool do bb:Destroy() end; table.clear(self._pool)
end
local DamageNumberSystem = {}
function DamageNumberSystem.new(parent: Instance): DamageNumberSystem
    return setmetatable({ _pool = {}, _parent = parent }, Impl) :: any
end
return DamageNumberSystem

-- LeaderboardManager — Server-authoritative score tracking
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
export type LeaderboardEntry = { userId: number, playerName: string, score: number, rank: number }
export type Leaderboard = {
    SetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, score: number) -> (),
    GetScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    AddScore: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player, delta: number) -> number,
    GetTop: (self: Leaderboard, count: number) -> {LeaderboardEntry},
    GetRank: (self: Leaderboard, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: Leaderboard) -> (),
}
type Internal = Leaderboard & { _scores: {[Player]: number}, _sorted: {LeaderboardEntry}?, _dirty: boolean, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
local function rebuild(self: Internal)
    local entries: {LeaderboardEntry} = {}
    for p, s in self._scores do table.insert(entries, { userId = p.UserId, playerName = p.Name, score = s, rank = 0 }) end
    table.sort(entries, function(a, b) return a.score > b.score end)
    for i, e in entries do e.rank = i end
    self._sorted = entries; self._dirty = false
end
function Impl.SetScore(self: Internal, player: Player, score: number) self._scores[player] = score; self._dirty = true end
function Impl.GetScore(self: Internal, player: Player): number return self._scores[player] or 0 end
function Impl.AddScore(self: Internal, player: Player, delta: number): number
    local new = (self._scores[player] or 0) + delta; self._scores[player] = new; self._dirty = true; return new
end
function Impl.GetTop(self: Internal, count: number): {LeaderboardEntry}
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    local r: {LeaderboardEntry} = {}; for i = 1, math.min(count, #(self._sorted :: {LeaderboardEntry})) do table.insert(r, (self._sorted :: {LeaderboardEntry})[i]) end; return r
end
function Impl.GetRank(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    if self._dirty or not self._sorted then rebuild(self) end
    for _, e in self._sorted :: {LeaderboardEntry} do if e.userId == player.UserId then return e.rank end end; return -1
end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) table.clear(self._scores); self._sorted = nil; self._dirty = true end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._scores) end
local Leaderboard = {}
function Leaderboard.new(): Leaderboard
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _scores = {}, _sorted = nil, _dirty = true, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._scores[p] = nil; self._dirty = true end))
    return self :: Leaderboard
end
return Leaderboard

export type AbilityCooldowns = {
    StartCooldown: (self: AbilityCooldowns, player: Player, abilityId: string) -> (),
    IsReady: (self: AbilityCooldowns, player: Player, abilityId: string) -> boolean,
    GetRemaining: (self: AbilityCooldowns, player: Player, abilityId: string) -> number,
    RegisterAbility: (self: AbilityCooldowns, abilityId: string, cooldown: number, group: string?) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: AbilityCooldowns) -> (),
}
type AbilityDef = { cooldown: number, group: string? }
type Entry = { startTime: number, duration: number }
type Internal = AbilityCooldowns & { _defs: {[string]: AbilityDef}, _groups: {[string]: CooldownGroup}, _data: {[Player]: {[string]: Entry}}, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.RegisterAbility(self: Internal, abilityId: string, cooldown: number, group: string?)
    self._defs[abilityId] = { cooldown = cooldown, group = group }
end
function Impl.StartCooldown(self: Internal, player: Player, abilityId: string)
    local def = self._defs[abilityId]; if not def then return end
    if not self._data[player] then self._data[player] = {} end
    self._data[player][abilityId] = { startTime = os.clock(), duration = def.cooldown }
    if def.group and self._groups[def.group] then
        for _, otherId in self._groups[def.group].abilities do
            if otherId ~= abilityId then
                local otherDef = self._defs[otherId]
                if otherDef then self._data[player][otherId] = { startTime = os.clock(), duration = self._groups[def.group].sharedCooldown } end
            end
        end
    end
end
function Impl.IsReady(self: Internal, player: Player, abilityId: string): boolean
    local e = self._data[player] and self._data[player][abilityId]; if not e then return true end
    return (os.clock() - e.startTime) >= e.duration
end
function Impl.GetRemaining(self: Internal, player: Player, abilityId: string): number
    local e = self._data[player] and self._data[player][abilityId]; if not e then return 0 end
    return math.max(0, e.duration - (os.clock() - e.startTime))
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data) end
local AbilityCooldowns = {}
function AbilityCooldowns.new(): AbilityCooldowns
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _defs = {}, _groups = {}, _data = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._data[p] = nil end))

--!strict
-- TeamManager — Server-authoritative team assignment and scoring
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
export type TeamDef = { id: string, name: string, color: Color3, maxPlayers: number }
export type TeamManager = {
    AssignTeam: (self: TeamManager, player: Player, teamId: string) -> boolean,
    GetTeam: (self: TeamManager, player: Player) -> string?,
    GetTeamPlayers: (self: TeamManager, teamId: string) -> {Player},
    GetTeamScore: (self: TeamManager, teamId: string) -> number,
    AddTeamScore: (self: TeamManager, teamId: string, delta: number) -> number,
    AutoAssign: (self: TeamManager, player: Player) -> string?,
    Destroy: (self: TeamManager) -> (),
}
type Internal = TeamManager & { _teams: {[string]: TeamDef}, _playerTeams: {[Player]: string}, _scores: {[string]: number}, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.AssignTeam(self: Internal, player: Player, teamId: string): boolean
    local def = self._teams[teamId]; if not def then return false end
    local count = 0; for _, t in self._playerTeams do if t == teamId then count += 1 end end
    if count >= def.maxPlayers then return false end
    self._playerTeams[player] = teamId; return true
end
function Impl.GetTeam(self: Internal, player: Player): string? return self._playerTeams[player] end
function Impl.GetTeamPlayers(self: Internal, teamId: string): {Player}
    local r: {Player} = {}; for p, t in self._playerTeams do if t == teamId then table.insert(r, p) end end; return r
end
function Impl.GetTeamScore(self: Internal, teamId: string): number return self._scores[teamId] or 0 end
function Impl.AddTeamScore(self: Internal, teamId: string, delta: number): number
    local new = (self._scores[teamId] or 0) + delta; self._scores[teamId] = new; return new
end
function Impl.AutoAssign(self: Internal, player: Player): string?
    local smallest, smallestCount = nil, math.huge
    for id, def in self._teams do
        local count = 0; for _, t in self._playerTeams do if t == id then count += 1 end end
        if count < def.maxPlayers and count < smallestCount then smallest = id; smallestCount = count end
    end
    if smallest then self:AssignTeam(player, smallest) end; return smallest
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end; table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._playerTeams) end
local TeamManager = {}
function TeamManager.new(teams: {[string]: TeamDef}): TeamManager
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _teams = teams, _playerTeams = {}, _scores = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    for id in teams do self._scores[id] = 0 end
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._playerTeams[p] = nil end))
    return self :: TeamManager
end
return TeamManager

-- QuestTracker — Server-side quest progress tracking
export type ObjectiveType = "Kill" | "Collect" | "Reach" | "Talk" | "Escort"
export type Objective = { id: string, type: ObjectiveType, target: string, required: number, description: string }
export type QuestDef = { id: string, name: string, description: string, objectives: {Objective}, rewards: {[string]: number} }
export type QuestProgress = { questId: string, objectiveProgress: {[string]: number}, isComplete: boolean, completedAt: number? }
export type QuestSystem = {
    StartQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    UpdateProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number) -> boolean,
    IsComplete: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> boolean,
    GetProgress: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> QuestProgress?,
    AbandonQuest: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player, questId: string) -> (),
    GetActiveQuests: (self: QuestSystem, player: Player) -> {QuestProgress},
}
type Internal = QuestSystem & { _defs: {[string]: QuestDef}, _progress: {[Player]: {[string]: QuestProgress}} }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.StartQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    if not self._progress[player] then self._progress[player] = {} end
    if self._progress[player][questId] then return false end
    local prog: {[string]: number} = {}; for _, obj in def.objectives do prog[obj.id] = 0 end
    self._progress[player][questId] = { questId = questId, objectiveProgress = prog, isComplete = false }
    return true
end
function Impl.UpdateProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string, objectiveId: string, amount: number): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]; if not p or p.isComplete then return false end
    local def = self._defs[questId]; if not def then return false end
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if obj.id == objectiveId then
            p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] = math.min((p.objectiveProgress[objectiveId] or 0) + amount, obj.required)
            break
        end
    end
    local allDone = true
    for _, obj in def.objectives do
        if (p.objectiveProgress[obj.id] or 0) < obj.required then allDone = false; break end
    end
    if allDone then p.isComplete = true; p.completedAt = os.time() end
    return true
end
function Impl.IsComplete(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): boolean
    local p = self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]; return p ~= nil and p.isComplete
end
function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string): QuestProgress?
    return self._progress[player] and self._progress[player][questId]
end
function Impl.AbandonQuest(self: Internal, player: Player, questId: string)
    local pp = self._progress[player]; if pp then pp[questId] = nil end
end
function Impl.GetActiveQuests(self: Internal, player: Player): {QuestProgress}
    local r: {QuestProgress} = {}; local pp = self._progress[player]
    if pp then for _, p in pp do if not p.isComplete then table.insert(r, p) end end end; return r
end
local QuestSystem = {}
function QuestSystem.new(quests: {[string]: QuestDef}): QuestSystem
    return setmetatable({ _defs = quests, _progress = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return QuestSystem

local function ensure(self: Internal, bits: number)

    local e = self._data[player] and self._data[player][action]

end

    local pe = self._data[player]; if pe then pe[action] = nil end
end

    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data)

    Add: (self: Inventory, itemId: string, qty: number) -> boolean,
    Remove: (self: Inventory, itemId: string, qty: number) -> boolean,

    OnChange: (self: Inventory, cb: () -> ()) -> (),
}

Impl.__index = Impl

    if qty <= 0 then return false end
    local def = self._defs[itemId]; if not def then return false end
    local cur = self._slots[itemId] or 0
    if cur == 0 then local n = 0; for _ in self._slots do n += 1 end; if n >= self._cap then return false end end
    if cur + qty > def.maxStack then return false end
    self._slots[itemId] = cur + qty; if self._onChange then self._onChange() end; return true
end

function Impl.Remove(self: Internal, itemId: string, qty: number): boolean
    if qty <= 0 then return false end
    local cur = self._slots[itemId] or 0; if cur < qty then return false end
    local nq = cur - qty
    if nq <= 0 then self._slots[itemId] = nil else self._slots[itemId] = nq end
    if self._onChange then self._onChange() end; return true
end

function Impl.Has(self: Internal, itemId: string, qty: number?): boolean return (self._slots[itemId] or 0) >= (qty or 1) end
function Impl.Count(self: Internal, itemId: string): number return self._slots[itemId] or 0 end

function Impl.GetSlots(self: Internal): {Slot}
    local r: {Slot} = {}; for id, q in self._slots do table.insert(r, { itemId = id, quantity = q }) end; return r
end

function Impl.GetUsedSlots(self: Internal): number local n = 0; for _ in self._slots do n += 1 end; return n end
function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._cap end
function Impl.Clear(self: Internal) table.clear(self._slots); if self._onChange then self._onChange() end end
function Impl.OnChange(self: Internal, cb: () -> ()) self._onChange = cb end

function Inventory.new(capacity: number, defs: {[string]: ItemDef}): Inventory
    assert(capacity > 0)
    return setmetatable({ _slots = {}, _cap = capacity, _defs = defs, _onChange = nil }, Impl) :: any
end

    GiveTask: (self: Maid, task: MaidTask) -> MaidTask,
    GiveConnection: (self: Maid, conn: RBXScriptConnection) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    DoCleaning: (self: Maid) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: Maid) -> (),
    IsCleaning: (self: Maid) -> boolean,
}

type Internal = Maid & { _tasks: {MaidTask}, _cleaning: boolean }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function clean(task: MaidTask)
    local t = typeof(task)
    if t == "function" then (task :: () -> ())()
    elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local c = task :: RBXScriptConnection; if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local d: any = task; if d.Destroy then d:Destroy() end
    end
end

function Impl.GiveTask(self: Internal, task: MaidTask): MaidTask
    if self._cleaning then warn("[Maid] GiveTask during cleanup"); return task end
    table.insert(self._tasks, task)
    return task
end

function Impl.GiveConnection(self: Internal, conn: RBXScriptConnection): RBXScriptConnection
    self:GiveTask(conn :: any); return conn
end

function Impl.DoCleaning(self: Internal)
    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do
        pcall(clean, self._tasks[i])
    end
    table.clear(self._tasks)
    self._cleaning = false
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) self:DoCleaning() end
function Impl.IsCleaning(self: Internal): boolean return self._cleaning end

local Maid = {}
function Maid.new(): Maid
    return setmetatable({ _tasks = {}, _cleaning = false }, Impl) :: any
end
return Maid

-- ObjectPool — Factory-based instance pool

export type PoolConfig = {
    factory: () -> Instance,
    reset: ((Instance) -> ())?,
    initialSize: number,
    maxSize: number,
    parent: Instance?,
}

export type PooledItem = { instance: Instance, isActive: boolean, id: number }

export type ObjectPool = {
    Acquire: (self: ObjectPool) -> PooledItem?,
    Release: (self: ObjectPool, item: PooledItem) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
    GetActiveCount: (self: ObjectPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = ObjectPool & {
    _config: PoolConfig, _active: {[number]: PooledItem}, _idle: {PooledItem}, _nextId: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function makeItem(self: Internal): PooledItem
    local inst = self._config.factory()
    if self._config.parent then inst.Parent = self._config.parent end
    self._nextId += 1
    return { instance = inst, isActive = false, id = self._nextId }
end

local function resetInst(cfg: PoolConfig, inst: Instance)
    if cfg.reset then cfg.reset(inst); return end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        local p = inst :: BasePart
        p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Transparency = 1
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
        p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
end

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): PooledItem?
    local item: PooledItem?
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        item = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif self:GetActiveCount() < self._config.maxSize then
        item = makeItem(self)
    else
        return nil
    end
    item.isActive = true
    self._active[item.id] = item
    return item
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, item: PooledItem)
    if not item.isActive then return end
    item.isActive = false
    self._active[item.id] = nil
    resetInst(self._config, item.instance)
    table.insert(self._idle, item)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap = {}
    for _, item in self._active do table.insert(snap, item) end
    for _, item in snap do self:Release(item) end
end

function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number
    local n = 0; for _ in self._active do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, item in self._idle do item.instance:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

local ObjectPool = {}
function ObjectPool.new(config: PoolConfig): ObjectPool
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({
        _config = config, _active = {}, _idle = {}, _nextId = 0,
    }, Impl) :: any
    for _ = 1, config.initialSize do
        local item = makeItem(self)
        resetInst(config, item.instance)
        table.insert(self._idle, item)
    end
    return self :: ObjectPool
end
return ObjectPool

    Peek: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    PeekPriority: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number?,

local function siftUp<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, i: number)
    while i > 1 do
        local p = math.floor(i / 2)
        if h[i].priority < h[p].priority then h[i], h[p] = h[p], h[i]; i = p else break end
    end
end

local function siftDown<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, n: number, i: number)
    while true do
        local s, l, r = i, i*2, i*2+1
        if l <= n and h[l].priority < h[s].priority then s = l end
        if r <= n and h[r].priority < h[s].priority then s = r end
        if s == i then break end
        h[i], h[s] = h[s], h[i]; i = s
    end
end

    local root = self._heap[1]
    self._heap[1] = self._heap[self._size]

    self._size -= 1
    if self._size > 0 then siftDown(self._heap, self._size, 1) end
    return root.value
end

    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].value
end

    PeekPriority: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number?,

type Entry<T> = { value: T, priority: number }
type Internal<T> = PriorityQueue<T> & { _heap: {Entry<T>}, _size: number }

Impl.__index = Impl

local function siftUp<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, i: number)
    while i > 1 do
        local p = math.floor(i / 2)
        if h[i].priority < h[p].priority then h[i], h[p] = h[p], h[i]; i = p else break end
    end
end

    return root.value

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type BucketConfig = { maxTokens: number, refillRate: number }
export type RateLimiter = {
    Attempt: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player, cost: number?) -> boolean,
    Peek: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: RateLimiter) -> (),
}

type Bucket = { tokens: number, lastRefill: number }
type Internal = RateLimiter & { _buckets: {[Player]: Bucket}, _config: BucketConfig, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function refill(b: Bucket, c: BucketConfig)
    local now = os.clock()
    b.tokens = math.min(c.maxTokens, b.tokens + (now - b.lastRefill) * c.refillRate)
    b.lastRefill = now
end

function Impl.Attempt(self: Internal, player: Player, cost: number?): boolean
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return false end
    refill(b, self._config)
    local c = cost or 1
    if b.tokens >= c then b.tokens -= c; return true end
    return false
end

function Impl.Peek(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return 0 end
    refill(b, self._config); return b.tokens
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal, player: Player)
    local b = self._buckets[player]
    if b then b.tokens = self._config.maxTokens; b.lastRefill = os.clock() end
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._buckets)
end

local RateLimiter = {}
function RateLimiter.new(config: BucketConfig): RateLimiter
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _buckets = {}, _config = config, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._buckets[p] = nil end))
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end
    return self :: RateLimiter
end

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    GetListenerCount: (self: Signal<T...>) -> number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._listeners[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._listeners[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._listeners do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

function SigImpl.GetListenerCount<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): number
    local n = 0
    for _ in self._listeners do n += 1 end
    return n
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} }, SigImpl) :: any
end

--!strict

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Callback-dictionary event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    GetListenerCount: (self: Signal<T...>) -> number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._listeners[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._listeners[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._listeners do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

function SigImpl.GetListenerCount<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): number
    local n = 0
    for _ in self._listeners do n += 1 end
    return n
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

export type GridEntry = { id: number, position: Vector3 }
export type SpatialGrid = {
    Insert: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Remove: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Move: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3) -> (),
    QueryRadius: (self: SpatialGrid, center: Vector3, radius: number) -> {GridEntry},
    Clear: (self: SpatialGrid) -> (),
}

    _cellSize: number, _inv: number,
    _cells: {[number]: {[number]: GridEntry}},
    _posIndex: {[number]: (number, number)},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function hash(cx: number, cz: number): number
    local a, b = cx + 32768, cz + 32768
    return math.floor((a + b) * (a + b + 1) / 2 + b)
end

local function toCell(x: number, z: number, inv: number): (number, number)
    return math.floor(x * inv), math.floor(z * inv)
end

function Impl.Insert(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local h = hash(cx, cz)
    if not self._cells[h] then self._cells[h] = {} end
    self._cells[h][id] = { id = id, position = pos }
    self._posIndex[id] = (cx, cz)
end

function Impl.Remove(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local cell = self._cells[hash(cx, cz)]
    if cell then cell[id] = nil end
    self._posIndex[id] = nil
end

function Impl.Move(self: Internal, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3)
    local ocx, ocz = toCell(old.X, old.Z, self._inv)
    local ncx, ncz = toCell(new.X, new.Z, self._inv)
    if ocx == ncx and ocz == ncz then
        local cell = self._cells[hash(ocx, ocz)]
        if cell and cell[id] then cell[id].position = new end
        return
    end
    self:Remove(id, old); self:Insert(id, new)
end

function Impl.QueryRadius(self: Internal, center: Vector3, radius: number): {GridEntry}
    local r: {GridEntry} = {}
    local cx, cz = toCell(center.X, center.Z, self._inv)
    local range = math.ceil(radius * self._inv)
    local rSq = radius * radius
    for dx = -range, range do
        for dz = -range, range do
            local cell = self._cells[hash(cx + dx, cz + dz)]
            if cell then
                for _, e in cell do
                    local d = center - e.position
                    if d:Dot(d) <= rSq then table.insert(r, e) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return r
end

function SpatialGrid.new(cellSize: number): SpatialGrid
    assert(cellSize > 0)
    return setmetatable({ _cellSize = cellSize, _inv = 1/cellSize, _cells = {}, _posIndex = {} }, Impl) :: any
end

        if cur and cur.canTransitionTo then
            local ok = false
            for _, t in cur.canTransitionTo do if t == to then ok = true; break end end
            if not ok then return false end
        end
        if cur and cur.exit then cur.exit() end

    local c = self._states[self._current]; if not c or not c.canTransitionTo then return false end
    for _, t in c.canTransitionTo do if t == to then return true end end; return false
end

    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.exit then c.exit() end; table.clear(self._states)
end

-- StateMachine — Generic finite state machine
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type StateDef = {
    name: string,
    enter: (() -> ())?,
    update: ((dt: number) -> ())?,
    exit: (() -> ())?,
    canTransitionTo: {string},
}

export type StateMachine = {
    Transition: (self: StateMachine, to: string) -> boolean,
    Update: (self: StateMachine, dt: number) -> (),
    GetCurrent: (self: StateMachine) -> string,
    GetTimeInState: (self: StateMachine) -> number,
    IsIn: (self: StateMachine, state: string) -> boolean,
    CanTransition: (self: StateMachine, to: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: StateMachine) -> (),
}

type Internal = StateMachine & { _states: {[string]: StateDef}, _current: string, _startTime: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Transition(self: Internal, to: string): boolean
    local target = self._states[to]; if not target then return false end
    if self._current ~= "" then
        local cur = self._states[self._current]
        if cur and cur.canTransitionTo then
            local ok = false
            for _, t in cur.canTransitionTo do if t == to then ok = true; break end end
            if not ok then return false end
        end
        if cur and cur.exit then cur.exit() end
    end
    self._current = to; self._startTime = os.clock()
    if target.enter then target.enter() end
    return true
end

function Impl.Update(self: Internal, dt: number)
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.update then c.update(dt) end
end

function Impl.GetCurrent(self: Internal): string return self._current end
function Impl.GetTimeInState(self: Internal): number return os.clock() - self._startTime end
function Impl.IsIn(self: Internal, s: string): boolean return self._current == s end
function Impl.CanTransition(self: Internal, to: string): boolean
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if not c or not c.canTransitionTo then return false end
    for _, t in c.canTransitionTo do if t == to then return true end end; return false
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.exit then c.exit() end; table.clear(self._states)
end

local StateMachine = {}
function StateMachine.new(states: {StateDef}, initial: string): StateMachine
    local map: {[string]: StateDef} = {}; for _, d in states do map[d.name] = d end
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _states = map, _current = "", _startTime = 0 }, Impl) :: any
    if initial ~= "" then self:Transition(initial) end
    return self :: StateMachine
end
return StateMachine

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Array-indexed event system with priority
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Listener<T...> = {
    callback: (T...) -> (),
    priority: number,
    index: number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {Listener<T...>},
    _nextIndex: number,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local sig = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local idx = (self :: any)._index :: number
    for i, listener in sig._listeners do
        if listener.index == idx then
            table.remove(sig._listeners, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

local function insertSorted<T...>(listeners: {Listener<T...>}, entry: Listener<T...>)
    for i = 1, #listeners do
        if entry.priority > listeners[i].priority then
            table.insert(listeners, i, entry)
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(listeners, entry)
end

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?): Connection
    self._nextIndex += 1
    local entry: Listener<T...> = {
        callback = callback,
        priority = priority or 0,
        index = self._nextIndex,
    }
    insertSorted(self._listeners, entry)
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _index = entry.index,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for _, listener in self._listeners do
        task.spawn(listener.callback, ...)
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {}, _nextIndex = 0 }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- SessionLock — DataStore session locking with stale detection
export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }
export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}
type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end
function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end); return ok
end
function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end
function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end
local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock

    GetActiveCount: (self: TweenScheduler) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: TweenScheduler) -> (),
}

type Internal = TweenScheduler & { _tweens: {[TweenHandle]: TweenEntry}, _conn: RBXScriptConnection? }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Tween(self: Internal, startVal: number, config: TweenConfig, callback: (number) -> ()): TweenHandle
    local entry: TweenEntry = { start = startVal, target = config.target, duration = config.duration, elapsed = 0, easing = config.easing, callback = callback, active = true }
    local handle: any = { Cancel = function(h) entry.active = false; self._tweens[h] = nil end, IsActive = function() return entry.active end }
    self._tweens[handle] = entry
    if not self._conn then

            local toRemove = {}

                if not e.active then table.insert(toRemove, h); continue end
                e.elapsed += dt
                local t = math.clamp(e.elapsed / e.duration, 0, 1)
                local eased = e.easing(t)
                e.callback(e.start + (e.target - e.start) * eased)
                if t >= 1 then e.active = false; table.insert(toRemove, h) end
            end
            for _, h in toRemove do self._tweens[h] = nil end
            if next(self._tweens) == nil and self._conn then (self._conn :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect(); self._conn = nil end
        end)
    end
    return handle :: TweenHandle
end

function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number local n = 0; for _ in self._tweens do n += 1 end; return n end

export type Connection = {

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,

    FireDeferred: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    FireImmediate: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    Flush: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _connections: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
    _queue: {{T...}},
    _flushScheduled: boolean,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._connections[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._connections[callback] = true

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection

    conn = self:Connect(w)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.FireDeferred<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    table.insert(self._queue, {...})
    if not self._flushScheduled then
        self._flushScheduled = true
        task.defer(function()
            self._flushScheduled = false
            self:Flush()
        end)
    end
end

function SigImpl.FireImmediate<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._connections do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.Flush<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    local queue = self._queue
    self._queue = {}
    for _, args in queue do
        for cb in self._connections do
            task.spawn(cb, table.unpack(args))
        end
    end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._connections)
    table.clear(self._queue)
end

    return setmetatable({ _connections = {}, _queue = {}, _flushScheduled = false }, SigImpl) :: any

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- StateMachine — Generic finite state machine
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type StateDef = {
    name: string,
    enter: (() -> ())?,
    update: ((dt: number) -> ())?,
    exit: (() -> ())?,
    canTransitionTo: {string},
}

export type StateMachine = {
    Transition: (self: StateMachine, to: string) -> boolean,
    Update: (self: StateMachine, dt: number) -> (),
    GetCurrent: (self: StateMachine) -> string,
    GetTimeInState: (self: StateMachine) -> number,
    IsIn: (self: StateMachine, state: string) -> boolean,
    CanTransition: (self: StateMachine, to: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: StateMachine) -> (),
}

type Internal = StateMachine & { _states: {[string]: StateDef}, _current: string, _startTime: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Transition(self: Internal, to: string): boolean
    local target = self._states[to]; if not target then return false end
    if self._current ~= "" then
        local cur = self._states[self._current]
        if cur and cur.canTransitionTo then
            local ok = false
            for _, t in cur.canTransitionTo do if t == to then ok = true; break end end
            if not ok then return false end
        end
        if cur and cur.exit then cur.exit() end
    end
    self._current = to; self._startTime = os.clock()
    if target.enter then target.enter() end
    return true
end

function Impl.Update(self: Internal, dt: number)
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.update then c.update(dt) end
end

function Impl.GetCurrent(self: Internal): string return self._current end
function Impl.GetTimeInState(self: Internal): number return os.clock() - self._startTime end
function Impl.IsIn(self: Internal, s: string): boolean return self._current == s end
function Impl.CanTransition(self: Internal, to: string): boolean
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if not c or not c.canTransitionTo then return false end
    for _, t in c.canTransitionTo do if t == to then return true end end; return false
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.exit then c.exit() end; table.clear(self._states)
end

local StateMachine = {}
function StateMachine.new(states: {StateDef}, initial: string): StateMachine
    local map: {[string]: StateDef} = {}; for _, d in states do map[d.name] = d end
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _states = map, _current = "", _startTime = 0 }, Impl) :: any
    if initial ~= "" then self:Transition(initial) end
    return self :: StateMachine
end
return StateMachine

-- SessionLock — DataStore session locking with stale detection
export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }
export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}
type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end
function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end); return ok
end
function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end
function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end
local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Deferred batch-execution event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    FireDeferred: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    FireImmediate: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    Flush: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _connections: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
    _queue: {{T...}},
    _flushScheduled: boolean,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._connections[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._connections[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({ Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function w(...: T...) if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end end
    conn = self:Connect(w)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.FireDeferred<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    table.insert(self._queue, {...})
    if not self._flushScheduled then
        self._flushScheduled = true
        task.defer(function()
            self._flushScheduled = false
            self:Flush()
        end)
    end
end

function SigImpl.FireImmediate<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._connections do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.Flush<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    local queue = self._queue
    self._queue = {}
    for _, args in queue do
        for cb in self._connections do
            task.spawn(cb, table.unpack(args))
        end
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._connections)
    table.clear(self._queue)
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _connections = {}, _queue = {}, _flushScheduled = false }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

        cum += e.weight
        if roll <= cum then return { itemId = e.itemId, quantity = math.random(e.minQty, e.maxQty) } end
    end
    local last = self._entries[#self._entries]
    return { itemId = last.itemId, quantity = math.random(last.minQty, last.maxQty) }

    for i, e in self._entries do

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SpatialGrid — Grid-based spatial hash
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type GridEntry = { id: number, position: Vector3 }
export type SpatialGrid = {
    Insert: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Remove: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Move: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3) -> (),
    QueryRadius: (self: SpatialGrid, center: Vector3, radius: number) -> {GridEntry},
    Clear: (self: SpatialGrid) -> (),
}

type Internal = SpatialGrid & {
    _cellSize: number, _inv: number,
    _cells: {[number]: {[number]: GridEntry}},
    _posIndex: {[number]: (number, number)},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function hash(cx: number, cz: number): number
    local a, b = cx + 32768, cz + 32768
    return math.floor((a + b) * (a + b + 1) / 2 + b)
end

local function toCell(x: number, z: number, inv: number): (number, number)
    return math.floor(x * inv), math.floor(z * inv)
end

function Impl.Insert(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local h = hash(cx, cz)
    if not self._cells[h] then self._cells[h] = {} end
    self._cells[h][id] = { id = id, position = pos }
    self._posIndex[id] = (cx, cz)
end

function Impl.Remove(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local cell = self._cells[hash(cx, cz)]
    if cell then cell[id] = nil end
    self._posIndex[id] = nil
end

function Impl.Move(self: Internal, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3)
    local ocx, ocz = toCell(old.X, old.Z, self._inv)
    local ncx, ncz = toCell(new.X, new.Z, self._inv)
    if ocx == ncx and ocz == ncz then
        local cell = self._cells[hash(ocx, ocz)]
        if cell and cell[id] then cell[id].position = new end
        return
    end
    self:Remove(id, old); self:Insert(id, new)
end

function Impl.QueryRadius(self: Internal, center: Vector3, radius: number): {GridEntry}
    local r: {GridEntry} = {}
    local cx, cz = toCell(center.X, center.Z, self._inv)
    local range = math.ceil(radius * self._inv)
    local rSq = radius * radius
    for dx = -range, range do
        for dz = -range, range do
            local cell = self._cells[hash(cx + dx, cz + dz)]
            if cell then
                for _, e in cell do
                    local d = center - e.position
                    if d:Dot(d) <= rSq then table.insert(r, e) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return r
end

function Impl.Clear(self: Internal) table.clear(self._cells); table.clear(self._posIndex) end

local SpatialGrid = {}
function SpatialGrid.new(cellSize: number): SpatialGrid
    assert(cellSize > 0)
    return setmetatable({ _cellSize = cellSize, _inv = 1/cellSize, _cells = {}, _posIndex = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return SpatialGrid

-- ObjectPool — Factory-based instance pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PoolConfig = {
    factory: () -> Instance,
    reset: ((Instance) -> ())?,
    initialSize: number,
    maxSize: number,
    parent: Instance?,
}

export type PooledItem = { instance: Instance, isActive: boolean, id: number }

export type ObjectPool = {
    Acquire: (self: ObjectPool) -> PooledItem?,
    Release: (self: ObjectPool, item: PooledItem) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
    GetActiveCount: (self: ObjectPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = ObjectPool & {
    _config: PoolConfig, _active: {[number]: PooledItem}, _idle: {PooledItem}, _nextId: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function makeItem(self: Internal): PooledItem
    local inst = self._config.factory()
    if self._config.parent then inst.Parent = self._config.parent end
    self._nextId += 1
    return { instance = inst, isActive = false, id = self._nextId }
end

local function resetInst(cfg: PoolConfig, inst: Instance)
    if cfg.reset then cfg.reset(inst); return end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        local p = inst :: BasePart
        p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Transparency = 1
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
        p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
end

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): PooledItem?
    local item: PooledItem?
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        item = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif self:GetActiveCount() < self._config.maxSize then
        item = makeItem(self)
    else
        return nil
    end
    item.isActive = true
    self._active[item.id] = item
    return item
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, item: PooledItem)
    if not item.isActive then return end
    item.isActive = false
    self._active[item.id] = nil
    resetInst(self._config, item.instance)
    table.insert(self._idle, item)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap = {}
    for _, item in self._active do table.insert(snap, item) end
    for _, item in snap do self:Release(item) end
end

function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number
    local n = 0; for _ in self._active do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, item in self._idle do item.instance:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

local ObjectPool = {}
function ObjectPool.new(config: PoolConfig): ObjectPool
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({
        _config = config, _active = {}, _idle = {}, _nextId = 0,
    }, Impl) :: any
    for _ = 1, config.initialSize do
        local item = makeItem(self)
        resetInst(config, item.instance)
        table.insert(self._idle, item)
    end
    return self :: ObjectPool
end
return ObjectPool

-- SessionLock — DataStore session locking with stale detection
export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }
export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}
type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end
function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end); return ok
end
function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end
function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end
local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Linked-list event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

type Node<T...> = {
    callback: (T...) -> (),
    next: Node<T...>?,
    prev: Node<T...>?,
    connection: Connection?,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _head: Node<T...>?,
    _count: number,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local node = (self :: any)._node :: Node<any>
    if node.prev then node.prev.next = node.next end
    if node.next then node.next.prev = node.prev end
    local sig = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    if sig._head == node then sig._head = node.next end
    sig._count -= 1
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local node: Node<T...> = {
        callback = callback,
        next = self._head,
        prev = nil,
    }
    if self._head then self._head.prev = node end
    self._head = node
    self._count += 1

    local conn = setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _node = node, _signal = self,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
    node.connection = conn
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    local node = self._head
    while node do
        local next = node.next
        task.spawn(node.callback, ...)
        node = next
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    local node = self._head
    while node do
        local next = node.next
        node.next = nil
        node.prev = nil
        if node.connection then node.connection.Connected = false end
        node = next
    end
    self._head = nil
    self._count = 0
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _head = nil, _count = 0 }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ObjectPool — Fixed-size ring buffer pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RingPool = {
    Acquire: (self: RingPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: RingPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    GetAvailable: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    GetCapacity: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: RingPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = RingPool & {
    _buffer: {Instance?},
    _head: number,
    _tail: number,
    _count: number,
    _capacity: number,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance?,
}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    if self._count <= 0 then return nil end
    local inst = self._buffer[self._head]
    self._buffer[self._head] = nil
    self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
    self._count -= 1
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if self._count >= self._capacity then
        instance:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self._tail = (self._tail % self._capacity) + 1
    self._buffer[self._tail] = instance
    self._count += 1
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
end

function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._capacity end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for i = 1, self._capacity do
        local inst = self._buffer[i]
        if inst then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(self._buffer)
end

local RingPool = {}
function RingPool.new(template: Instance, capacity: number, parent: Instance?): RingPool
    local buf: {Instance?} = table.create(capacity, nil)
    return setmetatable({
        _buffer = buf, _head = 1, _tail = 0, _count = 0,
        _capacity = capacity, _template = template, _parent = parent,
    }, Impl) :: any
end

    Roll: (self: LootTable) -> LootDrop,
    RollMany: (self: LootTable, count: number) -> {LootDrop},
    GetTotalWeight: (self: LootTable) -> number,
    Add: (self: LootTable, entry: LootEntry) -> (),

}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Roll(self: Internal): LootDrop
    if self._totalWeight <= 0 or #self._entries == 0 then return { itemId = "", quantity = 0 } end
    local roll, cum = math.random() * self._totalWeight, 0
    for _, e in self._entries do
        cum += e.weight
        if roll <= cum then return { itemId = e.itemId, quantity = math.random(e.minQty, e.maxQty) } end
    end
    local last = self._entries[#self._entries]
    return { itemId = last.itemId, quantity = math.random(last.minQty, last.maxQty) }
end

function Impl.RollMany(self: Internal, count: number): {LootDrop}
    local r: {LootDrop} = {}; for _ = 1, count do table.insert(r, self:Roll()) end; return r
end

function Impl.Add(self: Internal, entry: LootEntry) table.insert(self._entries, entry); self._totalWeight += entry.weight end

function Impl.Remove(self: Internal, itemId: string)
    for i, e in self._entries do
        if e.itemId == itemId then self._totalWeight -= e.weight; table.remove(self._entries, i); return end
    end
end

function LootTable.new(entries: {LootEntry}?): LootTable
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _entries = {}, _totalWeight = 0 }, Impl) :: any
    if entries then for _, e in entries do self:Add(e) end end
    return self :: LootTable
end

-- RateLimiter — Token bucket per-player rate limiter
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type BucketConfig = { maxTokens: number, refillRate: number }
export type RateLimiter = {
    Attempt: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player, cost: number?) -> boolean,
    Peek: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: RateLimiter) -> (),
}

type Bucket = { tokens: number, lastRefill: number }
type Internal = RateLimiter & { _buckets: {[Player]: Bucket}, _config: BucketConfig, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function refill(b: Bucket, c: BucketConfig)
    local now = os.clock()
    b.tokens = math.min(c.maxTokens, b.tokens + (now - b.lastRefill) * c.refillRate)
    b.lastRefill = now
end

function Impl.Attempt(self: Internal, player: Player, cost: number?): boolean
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return false end
    refill(b, self._config)
    local c = cost or 1
    if b.tokens >= c then b.tokens -= c; return true end
    return false
end

function Impl.Peek(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return 0 end
    refill(b, self._config); return b.tokens
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal, player: Player)
    local b = self._buckets[player]
    if b then b.tokens = self._config.maxTokens; b.lastRefill = os.clock() end
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._buckets)
end

local RateLimiter = {}
function RateLimiter.new(config: BucketConfig): RateLimiter
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _buckets = {}, _config = config, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._buckets[p] = nil end))
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end
    return self :: RateLimiter
end
return RateLimiter

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ObjectPool — Fixed-size ring buffer pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RingPool = {
    Acquire: (self: RingPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: RingPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    GetAvailable: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    GetCapacity: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: RingPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = RingPool & {
    _buffer: {Instance?},
    _head: number,
    _tail: number,
    _count: number,
    _capacity: number,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance?,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    if self._count <= 0 then return nil end
    local inst = self._buffer[self._head]
    self._buffer[self._head] = nil
    self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
    self._count -= 1
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if self._count >= self._capacity then
        instance:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self._tail = (self._tail % self._capacity) + 1
    self._buffer[self._tail] = instance
    self._count += 1
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
end

function Impl.GetAvailable(self: Internal): number return self._count end
function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._capacity end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for i = 1, self._capacity do
        local inst = self._buffer[i]
        if inst then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(self._buffer)
end

local RingPool = {}
function RingPool.new(template: Instance, capacity: number, parent: Instance?): RingPool
    local buf: {Instance?} = table.create(capacity, nil)
    return setmetatable({
        _buffer = buf, _head = 1, _tail = 0, _count = 0,
        _capacity = capacity, _template = template, _parent = parent,
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return RingPool

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- ObjectPool — CollectionService tag-based pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

export type TaggedPool = {
    Acquire: (self: TaggedPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: TaggedPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
    GetActive: (self: TaggedPool) -> {Instance},
    Destroy: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = TaggedPool & {
    _tag: string,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance,
    _active: {[Instance]: boolean},
    _idle: {Instance},
    _maxSize: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    local inst: Instance
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        inst = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif #self:GetActive() < self._maxSize then
        inst = self._template:Clone()
        CollectionService:AddTag(inst, self._tag)
    else
        return nil
    end
    inst.Parent = self._parent
    self._active[inst] = true
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if not self._active[instance] then return end
    self._active[instance] = nil
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
    instance.Parent = nil
    table.insert(self._idle, instance)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(snap, inst) end
    for _, inst in snap do self:Release(inst) end
end

function Impl.GetActive(self: Internal): {Instance}
    local r: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(r, inst) end
    return r
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, inst in self._idle do inst:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

local TaggedPool = {}
function TaggedPool.new(tag: string, template: Instance, parent: Instance, maxSize: number): TaggedPool
    return setmetatable({
        _tag = tag, _template = template, _parent = parent,
        _active = {}, _idle = {}, _maxSize = maxSize,
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return TaggedPool
