-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- SpatialGrid — Grid-based spatial hash
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type GridEntry = { id: number, position: Vector3 }
export type SpatialGrid = {
    Insert: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Remove: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, pos: Vector3) -> (),
    Move: (self: SpatialGrid, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3) -> (),
    QueryRadius: (self: SpatialGrid, center: Vector3, radius: number) -> {GridEntry},
    Clear: (self: SpatialGrid) -> (),
}

type Internal = SpatialGrid & {
    _cellSize: number, _inv: number,
    _cells: {[number]: {[number]: GridEntry}},
    _posIndex: {[number]: (number, number)},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function hash(cx: number, cz: number): number
    local a, b = cx + 32768, cz + 32768
    return math.floor((a + b) * (a + b + 1) / 2 + b)
end

local function toCell(x: number, z: number, inv: number): (number, number)
    return math.floor(x * inv), math.floor(z * inv)
end

function Impl.Insert(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local h = hash(cx, cz)
    if not self._cells[h] then self._cells[h] = {} end
    self._cells[h][id] = { id = id, position = pos }
    self._posIndex[id] = (cx, cz)
end

function Impl.Remove(self: Internal, id: number, pos: Vector3)
    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local cell = self._cells[hash(cx, cz)]
    if cell then cell[id] = nil end
    self._posIndex[id] = nil
end

function Impl.Move(self: Internal, id: number, old: Vector3, new: Vector3)
    local ocx, ocz = toCell(old.X, old.Z, self._inv)
    local ncx, ncz = toCell(new.X, new.Z, self._inv)
    if ocx == ncx and ocz == ncz then
        local cell = self._cells[hash(ocx, ocz)]
        if cell and cell[id] then cell[id].position = new end
        return
    end
    self:Remove(id, old); self:Insert(id, new)
end

function Impl.QueryRadius(self: Internal, center: Vector3, radius: number): {GridEntry}
    local r: {GridEntry} = {}
    local cx, cz = toCell(center.X, center.Z, self._inv)
    local range = math.ceil(radius * self._inv)
    local rSq = radius * radius
    for dx = -range, range do
        for dz = -range, range do
            local cell = self._cells[hash(cx + dx, cz + dz)]
            if cell then
                for _, e in cell do
                    local d = center - e.position
                    if d:Dot(d) <= rSq then table.insert(r, e) end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return r
end

function Impl.Clear(self: Internal) table.clear(self._cells); table.clear(self._posIndex) end

local SpatialGrid = {}
function SpatialGrid.new(cellSize: number): SpatialGrid
    assert(cellSize > 0)
    return setmetatable({ _cellSize = cellSize, _inv = 1/cellSize, _cells = {}, _posIndex = {} }, Impl) :: any
end
return SpatialGrid

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- BitBuffer — Binary serialization for network payloads
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type BitBuffer = {
    WriteUInt: (self: BitBuffer, value: number, bits: number) -> (),
    WriteBool: (self: BitBuffer, value: boolean) -> (),
    WriteFloat: (self: BitBuffer, value: number) -> (),
    WriteString: (self: BitBuffer, value: string) -> (),
    ReadUInt: (self: BitBuffer, bits: number) -> number,
    ReadBool: (self: BitBuffer) -> boolean,
    ReadFloat: (self: BitBuffer) -> number,
    ReadString: (self: BitBuffer) -> string,
    GetSize: (self: BitBuffer) -> number,
    Reset: (self: BitBuffer) -> (),
    Export: (self: BitBuffer) -> buffer,
}

type Internal = BitBuffer & { _buf: buffer, _cursor: number, _size: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function ensure(self: Internal, bits: number)
    if bits <= self._size * 8 - self._cursor then return end
    local ns = math.max(self._size * 2, math.ceil((self._cursor + bits) / 8))
    local nb = buffer.create(ns); buffer.copy(nb, 0, self._buf, 0, self._size)
    self._buf = nb; self._size = ns
end

function Impl.WriteUInt(self: Internal, value: number, bits: number)
    ensure(self, bits)
    local byte = math.floor(self._cursor / 8)
    local bit = self._cursor % 8
    local mask = bit32.lshift(1, bits) - 1
    local current = buffer.readu32(self._buf, byte)
    current = bit32.band(current, bit32.bnot(bit32.lshift(mask, bit)))
    current = bit32.bor(current, bit32.lshift(bit32.band(value, mask), bit))
    buffer.writeu32(self._buf, byte, current)
    self._cursor += bits
end

function Impl.WriteBool(self: Internal, value: boolean) self:WriteUInt(value and 1 or 0, 1) end

function Impl.WriteFloat(self: Internal, value: number)
    ensure(self, 32); buffer.writef32(self._buf, math.floor(self._cursor / 8), value); self._cursor += 32
end

function Impl.WriteString(self: Internal, value: string)
    self:WriteUInt(#value, 16)
    for i = 1, #value do self:WriteUInt(string.byte(value, i), 8) end
end

function Impl.ReadUInt(self: Internal, bits: number): number
    local byte = math.floor(self._cursor / 8)
    local bit = self._cursor % 8
    self._cursor += bits
    local raw = bit32.rshift(buffer.readu32(self._buf, byte), bit)
    return bit32.band(raw, bit32.lshift(1, bits) - 1)
end

function Impl.ReadBool(self: Internal): boolean return self:ReadUInt(1) == 1 end

function Impl.ReadFloat(self: Internal): number
    local v = buffer.readf32(self._buf, math.floor(self._cursor / 8)); self._cursor += 32; return v
end

function Impl.ReadString(self: Internal): string
    local len = self:ReadUInt(16); local chars = {}
    for i = 1, len do table.insert(chars, string.char(self:ReadUInt(8))) end
    return table.concat(chars)
end

function Impl.GetSize(self: Internal): number return math.ceil(self._cursor / 8) end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._cursor = 0 end
function Impl.Export(self: Internal): buffer
    local out = buffer.create(self:GetSize()); buffer.copy(out, 0, self._buf, 0, self:GetSize()); return out
end

local BitBuffer = {}
function BitBuffer.new(initialSize: number?): BitBuffer
    local s = initialSize or 256
    return setmetatable({ _buf = buffer.create(s), _cursor = 0, _size = s }, Impl) :: any
end
return BitBuffer

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Timer — Frame-rate independent timer with state machine
-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TimerState = "Idle" | "Running" | "Paused" | "Completed"

export type Timer = {
    Start: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Pause: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Resume: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Stop: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Reset: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Update: (self: Timer, dt: number) -> (),
    GetState: (self: Timer) -> TimerState,
    GetElapsed: (self: Timer) -> number,
    GetRemaining: (self: Timer) -> number,
    GetProgress: (self: Timer) -> number,
    OnTick: (self: Timer, cb: (elapsed: number, progress: number) -> ()) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    OnComplete: (self: Timer, cb: () -> ()) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    Destroy: (self: Timer) -> (),
}

type Internal = Timer & {
    _duration: number, _elapsed: number, _state: TimerState,
    _ticks: {(number, number) -> ()}, _completes: {() -> ()},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Start(self: Internal) if self._state ~= "Running" then self._state = "Running"; self._elapsed = 0 end end
function Impl.Pause(self: Internal) if self._state == "Running" then self._state = "Paused" end end
function Impl.Resume(self: Internal) if self._state == "Paused" then self._state = "Running" end end
function Impl.Stop(self: Internal) self._state = "Idle"; self._elapsed = 0 end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._elapsed = 0; if self._state == "Completed" then self._state = "Idle" end end

function Impl.Update(self: Internal, dt: number)
    if self._state ~= "Running" then return end
    self._elapsed = math.min(self._elapsed + dt, self._duration)
    local p = self:GetProgress()
    for _, cb in self._ticks do task.spawn(cb, self._elapsed, p) end
    if self._elapsed >= self._duration then
        self._state = "Completed"
        for _, cb in self._completes do task.spawn(cb) end
    end
end

function Impl.GetState(self: Internal): TimerState return self._state end
function Impl.GetElapsed(self: Internal): number return self._elapsed end
function Impl.GetRemaining(self: Internal): number return math.max(0, self._duration - self._elapsed) end
function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal): number
    if self._duration <= 0 then return 1 end
    return math.clamp(self._elapsed / self._duration, 0, 1)
end

function Impl.OnTick(self: Internal, cb: (number, number) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
    table.insert(self._ticks, cb)
    return { Disconnect = function()
        for i, c in self._ticks do if c == cb then table.remove(self._ticks, i); return end end
    end, Connected = true } :: any
end

function Impl.OnComplete(self: Internal, cb: () -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
    table.insert(self._completes, cb)
    return { Disconnect = function()
        for i, c in self._completes do if c == cb then table.remove(self._completes, i); return end end
    end, Connected = true } :: any
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._ticks); table.clear(self._completes) end

local Timer = {}
function Timer.new(duration: number): Timer
    assert(duration > 0)
    return setmetatable({
        _duration = duration, _elapsed = 0, _state = "Idle" :: TimerState,
        _ticks = {}, _completes = {},
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return Timer

    local empty: DamageResult = { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = 0, killed = false }
    local d = self._data[player]
    if not d or d.hp <= 0 or amount <= 0 then
        return d and { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } or empty
    end

    local rem, sd = amount, 0
    if d.shield > 0 then sd = math.min(d.shield, rem); d.shield -= sd; rem -= sd end

}

Impl.__index = Impl

    local inst = self._config.factory()
    if self._config.parent then inst.Parent = self._config.parent end
    self._nextId += 1
    return { instance = inst, isActive = false, id = self._nextId }
end

local function resetInst(cfg: PoolConfig, inst: Instance)
    if cfg.reset then cfg.reset(inst); return end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then

    local item: PooledItem?
    if #self._idle > 0 then

    elseif self:GetActiveCount() < self._config.maxSize then
        item = makeItem(self)
    else

    end
    item.isActive = true
    self._active[item.id] = item
    return item

    item.isActive = false
    self._active[item.id] = nil
    resetInst(self._config, item.instance)
    table.insert(self._idle, item)
end

    local snap = {}
    for _, item in self._active do table.insert(snap, item) end
    for _, item in snap do self:Release(item) end
end

function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number
    local n = 0; for _ in self._active do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()

    table.clear(self._idle)
end

    for _ = 1, config.initialSize do

    local t = typeof(task)
    if t == "function" then (task :: () -> ())()
    elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local c = task :: RBXScriptConnection; if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local d: any = task; if d.Destroy then d:Destroy() end
    end
end

    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do

    if not self._topics[topic] then self._topics[topic] = {} end

    local subs = self._topics[topic]; if not subs then return 0 end
    local n = 0; for _ in subs do n += 1 end; return n

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Callback-dictionary event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    GetListenerCount: (self: Signal<T...>) -> number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._listeners[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._listeners[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._listeners do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

function SigImpl.GetListenerCount<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): number
    local n = 0
    for _ in self._listeners do n += 1 end
    return n
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

export type HealthData = { hp: number, maxHp: number, shield: number, maxShield: number, invulnUntil: number }
export type HealthSystem = {
    Create: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?) -> (),
    Damage: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> DamageResult,
    Heal: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> number,
    SetInvulnerable: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, seconds: number) -> (),
    Get: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> HealthData?,
    IsAlive: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: HealthSystem) -> (),
}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Create(self: Internal, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?)
    self._data[player] = { hp = maxHp, maxHp = maxHp, shield = 0, maxShield = maxShield or 0, invulnUntil = 0 }
end

function Impl.Damage(self: Internal, player: Player, amount: number): DamageResult
    local empty: DamageResult = { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = 0, killed = false }
    local d = self._data[player]
    if not d or d.hp <= 0 or amount <= 0 then
        return d and { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } or empty
    end
    if os.clock() < d.invulnUntil then return { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } end
    local rem, sd = amount, 0
    if d.shield > 0 then sd = math.min(d.shield, rem); d.shield -= sd; rem -= sd end
    local hd = math.min(d.hp, rem); d.hp -= hd
    return { total = sd + hd, shieldDmg = sd, healthDmg = hd, remaining = d.hp, killed = d.hp <= 0 }

    local d = self._data[player]; if not d or d.hp <= 0 then return 0 end
    local a = math.min(amount, d.maxHp - d.hp); d.hp += a; return a
end

    local d = self._data[player]; if d then d.invulnUntil = os.clock() + seconds end
end

function Impl.IsAlive(self: Internal, player: Player): boolean
    local d = self._data[player]; return d ~= nil and d.hp > 0
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data)
end

    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _data = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._data[p] = nil end))

-- RateLimiter — Token bucket per-player rate limiter
-- ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type BucketConfig = { maxTokens: number, refillRate: number }
export type RateLimiter = {
    Attempt: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player, cost: number?) -> boolean,
    Peek: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: RateLimiter) -> (),
}

type Bucket = { tokens: number, lastRefill: number }
type Internal = RateLimiter & { _buckets: {[Player]: Bucket}, _config: BucketConfig, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function refill(b: Bucket, c: BucketConfig)
    local now = os.clock()
    b.tokens = math.min(c.maxTokens, b.tokens + (now - b.lastRefill) * c.refillRate)
    b.lastRefill = now
end

function Impl.Attempt(self: Internal, player: Player, cost: number?): boolean
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return false end
    refill(b, self._config)
    local c = cost or 1
    if b.tokens >= c then b.tokens -= c; return true end
    return false
end

function Impl.Peek(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return 0 end
    refill(b, self._config); return b.tokens
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal, player: Player)
    local b = self._buckets[player]
    if b then b.tokens = self._config.maxTokens; b.lastRefill = os.clock() end
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._buckets)
end

local RateLimiter = {}
function RateLimiter.new(config: BucketConfig): RateLimiter
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _buckets = {}, _config = config, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._buckets[p] = nil end))
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end
    return self :: RateLimiter
end
return RateLimiter

-- ObjectPool — CollectionService tag-based pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

export type TaggedPool = {
    Acquire: (self: TaggedPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: TaggedPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
    GetActive: (self: TaggedPool) -> {Instance},
    Destroy: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = TaggedPool & {
    _tag: string,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance,
    _active: {[Instance]: boolean},
    _idle: {Instance},
    _maxSize: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    local inst: Instance
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        inst = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif #self:GetActive() < self._maxSize then
        inst = self._template:Clone()
        CollectionService:AddTag(inst, self._tag)
    else
        return nil
    end
    inst.Parent = self._parent
    self._active[inst] = true
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if not self._active[instance] then return end
    self._active[instance] = nil
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
    instance.Parent = nil
    table.insert(self._idle, instance)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(snap, inst) end
    for _, inst in snap do self:Release(inst) end
end

    local r: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(r, inst) end
    return r
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, inst in self._idle do inst:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

    return setmetatable({
        _tag = tag, _template = template, _parent = parent,
        _active = {}, _idle = {}, _maxSize = maxSize,

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Deferred batch-execution event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    FireDeferred: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    FireImmediate: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    Flush: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _connections: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
    _queue: {{T...}},
    _flushScheduled: boolean,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._connections[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._connections[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({ Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function w(...: T...) if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end end
    conn = self:Connect(w)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.FireDeferred<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    table.insert(self._queue, {...})
    if not self._flushScheduled then
        self._flushScheduled = true
        task.defer(function()
            self._flushScheduled = false
            self:Flush()
        end)
    end
end

function SigImpl.FireImmediate<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._connections do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.Flush<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    local queue = self._queue
    self._queue = {}
    for _, args in queue do
        for cb in self._connections do
            task.spawn(cb, table.unpack(args))
        end
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._connections)
    table.clear(self._queue)
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _connections = {}, _queue = {}, _flushScheduled = false }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    local t = typeof(task)
    if t == "function" then (task :: () -> ())()
    elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local c = task :: RBXScriptConnection; if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local d: any = task; if d.Destroy then d:Destroy() end
    end
end

end

    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do

    end
    table.clear(self._tasks)
    self._cleaning = false
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) self:DoCleaning() end

function Maid.new(): Maid
    return setmetatable({ _tasks = {}, _cleaning = false }, Impl) :: any
end

export type HealthData = { hp: number, maxHp: number, shield: number, maxShield: number, invulnUntil: number }
export type HealthSystem = {
    Create: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?) -> (),
    Damage: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> DamageResult,
    Heal: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> number,
    SetInvulnerable: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, seconds: number) -> (),
    Get: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> HealthData?,
    IsAlive: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: HealthSystem) -> (),
}

type Internal = HealthSystem & { _data: {[Player]: HealthData}, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Create(self: Internal, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?)
    self._data[player] = { hp = maxHp, maxHp = maxHp, shield = 0, maxShield = maxShield or 0, invulnUntil = 0 }
end

function Impl.Damage(self: Internal, player: Player, amount: number): DamageResult
    local empty: DamageResult = { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = 0, killed = false }
    local d = self._data[player]
    if not d or d.hp <= 0 or amount <= 0 then
        return d and { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } or empty
    end
    if os.clock() < d.invulnUntil then return { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } end
    local rem, sd = amount, 0
    if d.shield > 0 then sd = math.min(d.shield, rem); d.shield -= sd; rem -= sd end
    local hd = math.min(d.hp, rem); d.hp -= hd
    return { total = sd + hd, shieldDmg = sd, healthDmg = hd, remaining = d.hp, killed = d.hp <= 0 }
end

function Impl.Heal(self: Internal, player: Player, amount: number): number
    local d = self._data[player]; if not d or d.hp <= 0 then return 0 end
    local a = math.min(amount, d.maxHp - d.hp); d.hp += a; return a
end

function Impl.SetInvulnerable(self: Internal, player: Player, seconds: number)
    local d = self._data[player]; if d then d.invulnUntil = os.clock() + seconds end
end

function Impl.Get(self: Internal, player: Player): HealthData? return self._data[player] end
function Impl.IsAlive(self: Internal, player: Player): boolean
    local d = self._data[player]; return d ~= nil and d.hp > 0
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data)
end

local HealthSystem = {}
function HealthSystem.new(): HealthSystem
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _data = {}, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._data[p] = nil end))
    return self :: HealthSystem
end

-- SessionLock — DataStore session locking with stale detection
export type LockResult = { success: boolean, reason: string? }
export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,
    Release: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}
type LockInfo = { serverId: string, acquiredAt: number, lastRefresh: number }
type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }
local Impl = {}; Impl.__index = Impl
function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end
function Impl.Release(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    self._locks[key] = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end); return ok
end
function Impl.IsLocked(self: Internal, key: string): boolean return self._locks[key] ~= nil end
function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end
local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end
return SessionLock

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Maid — Deterministic resource cleanup
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type MaidTask = RBXScriptConnection | Instance | (() -> ()) | { Destroy: (self: any) -> () }
export type Maid = {
    GiveTask: (self: Maid, task: MaidTask) -> MaidTask,
    GiveConnection: (self: Maid, conn: RBXScriptConnection) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    DoCleaning: (self: Maid) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: Maid) -> (),
    IsCleaning: (self: Maid) -> boolean,
}

type Internal = Maid & { _tasks: {MaidTask}, _cleaning: boolean }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function clean(task: MaidTask)
    local t = typeof(task)
    if t == "function" then (task :: () -> ())()
    elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then
        local c = task :: RBXScriptConnection; if c.Connected then c:Disconnect() end
    elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local d: any = task; if d.Destroy then d:Destroy() end
    end
end

function Impl.GiveTask(self: Internal, task: MaidTask): MaidTask
    if self._cleaning then warn("[Maid] GiveTask during cleanup"); return task end
    table.insert(self._tasks, task)
    return task
end

function Impl.GiveConnection(self: Internal, conn: RBXScriptConnection): RBXScriptConnection
    self:GiveTask(conn :: any); return conn
end

function Impl.DoCleaning(self: Internal)
    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do
        pcall(clean, self._tasks[i])
    end
    table.clear(self._tasks)
    self._cleaning = false
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) self:DoCleaning() end
function Impl.IsCleaning(self: Internal): boolean return self._cleaning end

local Maid = {}
function Maid.new(): Maid
    return setmetatable({ _tasks = {}, _cleaning = false }, Impl) :: any
end
return Maid

-- ObjectPool — Fixed-size ring buffer pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RingPool = {
    Acquire: (self: RingPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: RingPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    GetAvailable: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    GetCapacity: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: RingPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = RingPool & {
    _buffer: {Instance?},
    _head: number,
    _tail: number,
    _count: number,
    _capacity: number,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance?,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    if self._count <= 0 then return nil end
    local inst = self._buffer[self._head]
    self._buffer[self._head] = nil
    self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
    self._count -= 1
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if self._count >= self._capacity then
        instance:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self._tail = (self._tail % self._capacity) + 1
    self._buffer[self._tail] = instance
    self._count += 1
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
end

function Impl.GetAvailable(self: Internal): number return self._count end
function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._capacity end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for i = 1, self._capacity do
        local inst = self._buffer[i]
        if inst then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(self._buffer)
end

local RingPool = {}
function RingPool.new(template: Instance, capacity: number, parent: Instance?): RingPool
    local buf: {Instance?} = table.create(capacity, nil)
    return setmetatable({
        _buffer = buf, _head = 1, _tail = 0, _count = 0,
        _capacity = capacity, _template = template, _parent = parent,
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return RingPool

    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then

}

    _cells: {[number]: {[number]: GridEntry}},

}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function hash(cx: number, cz: number): number
    local a, b = cx + 32768, cz + 32768
    return math.floor((a + b) * (a + b + 1) / 2 + b)
end

local function toCell(x: number, z: number, inv: number): (number, number)
    return math.floor(x * inv), math.floor(z * inv)
end

    local cx, cz = toCell(pos.X, pos.Z, self._inv)
    local h = hash(cx, cz)

    self._cells[h][id] = { id = id, position = pos }
    self._posIndex[id] = (cx, cz)
end

        return

end

-- Signal — Array-indexed event system with priority
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Listener<T...> = {
    callback: (T...) -> (),
    priority: number,
    index: number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {Listener<T...>},
    _nextIndex: number,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local sig = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local idx = (self :: any)._index :: number
    for i, listener in sig._listeners do
        if listener.index == idx then
            table.remove(sig._listeners, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

local function insertSorted<T...>(listeners: {Listener<T...>}, entry: Listener<T...>)
    for i = 1, #listeners do
        if entry.priority > listeners[i].priority then
            table.insert(listeners, i, entry)
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(listeners, entry)
end

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?): Connection
    self._nextIndex += 1
    local entry: Listener<T...> = {
        callback = callback,
        priority = priority or 0,
        index = self._nextIndex,
    }
    insertSorted(self._listeners, entry)
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _index = entry.index,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for _, listener in self._listeners do
        task.spawn(listener.callback, ...)
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {}, _nextIndex = 0 }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- Signal — Callback-dictionary event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    GetListenerCount: (self: Signal<T...>) -> number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._listeners[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._listeners[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._listeners do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

function SigImpl.GetListenerCount<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): number
    local n = 0
    for _ in self._listeners do n += 1 end
    return n
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ObjectPool — Fixed-size ring buffer pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type RingPool = {
    Acquire: (self: RingPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: RingPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    GetAvailable: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    GetCapacity: (self: RingPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: RingPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = RingPool & {
    _buffer: {Instance?},
    _head: number,
    _tail: number,
    _count: number,
    _capacity: number,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance?,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    if self._count <= 0 then return nil end
    local inst = self._buffer[self._head]
    self._buffer[self._head] = nil
    self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
    self._count -= 1
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if self._count >= self._capacity then
        instance:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self._tail = (self._tail % self._capacity) + 1
    self._buffer[self._tail] = instance
    self._count += 1
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
end

function Impl.GetAvailable(self: Internal): number return self._count end
function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._capacity end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for i = 1, self._capacity do
        local inst = self._buffer[i]
        if inst then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(self._buffer)
end

function RingPool.new(template: Instance, capacity: number, parent: Instance?): RingPool
    local buf: {Instance?} = table.create(capacity, nil)
    return setmetatable({
        _buffer = buf, _head = 1, _tail = 0, _count = 0,
        _capacity = capacity, _template = template, _parent = parent,
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return RingPool

    local t = typeof(task)
    if t == "function" then (task :: () -> ())()
    elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then

    elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
    elseif t == "table" then
        local d: any = task; if d.Destroy then d:Destroy() end
    end
end

end

    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for i = #self._tasks, 1, -1 do
        pcall(clean, self._tasks[i])
    end
    table.clear(self._tasks)
    self._cleaning = false
end

function Impl.IsCleaning(self: Internal): boolean return self._cleaning end

function Maid.new(): Maid
    return setmetatable({ _tasks = {}, _cleaning = false }, Impl) :: any
end

export type SessionLock = {
    Acquire: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> LockResult,

    IsLocked: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Refresh: (self: SessionLock, key: string) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: SessionLock) -> (),
}

type Internal = SessionLock & { _locks: {[string]: LockInfo}, _serverId: string, _staleThreshold: number, _store: DataStore }

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal, key: string): LockResult
    local lockKey = "lock_" .. key
    local success, existing = pcall(function() return self._store:GetAsync(lockKey) end)
    if success and existing and typeof(existing) == "table" then
        if existing.serverId ~= self._serverId then
            local age = os.time() - (existing.acquiredAt or 0)
            if age < self._staleThreshold then return { success = false, reason = "Locked by another server" } end
        end
    end
    local lockData: LockInfo = { serverId = self._serverId, acquiredAt = os.time(), lastRefresh = os.time() }
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync(lockKey, lockData) end)
    if ok then self._locks[key] = lockData; return { success = true } end
    return { success = false, reason = "DataStore error" }
end

    self._locks[key] = nil
    local ok = pcall(function() self._store:RemoveAsync("lock_" .. key) end); return ok
end

function Impl.Refresh(self: Internal, key: string): boolean
    local lock = self._locks[key]; if not lock then return false end
    lock.lastRefresh = os.time()
    return pcall(function() self._store:SetAsync("lock_" .. key, lock) end) :: boolean
end
function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._locks) end
local SessionLock = {}
function SessionLock.new(store: DataStore, serverId: string, staleThreshold: number?): SessionLock
    return setmetatable({ _locks = {}, _serverId = serverId, _staleThreshold = staleThreshold or 300, _store = store }, Impl) :: any
end

    Transition: (self: StateMachine, to: string) -> boolean,
    Update: (self: StateMachine, dt: number) -> (),

    GetTimeInState: (self: StateMachine) -> number,

    local target = self._states[to]; if not target then return false end
    if self._current ~= "" then

        if cur and cur.canTransitionTo then
            local ok = false
            for _, t in cur.canTransitionTo do if t == to then ok = true; break end end
            if not ok then return false end
        end
        if cur and cur.exit then cur.exit() end
    end
    self._current = to; self._startTime = os.clock()
    if target.enter then target.enter() end
    return true
end

end

function Impl.CanTransition(self: Internal, to: string): boolean

    local c = self._states[self._current]; if c and c.exit then c.exit() end; table.clear(self._states)
end

    Release: (self: RingPool, instance: Instance) -> (),

    GetCapacity: (self: RingPool) -> number,

    local inst = self._buffer[self._head]

    self._head = (self._head % self._capacity) + 1
    self._count -= 1
    return inst
end

    if self._count >= self._capacity then
        instance:Destroy()
        return
    end
    self._tail = (self._tail % self._capacity) + 1
    self._buffer[self._tail] = instance
    self._count += 1
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then

        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
end

function Impl.GetCapacity(self: Internal): number return self._capacity end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for i = 1, self._capacity do
        local inst = self._buffer[i]
        if inst then inst:Destroy() end
    end
    table.clear(self._buffer)
end

local RingPool = {}
function RingPool.new(template: Instance, capacity: number, parent: Instance?): RingPool
    local buf: {Instance?} = table.create(capacity, nil)
    return setmetatable({
        _buffer = buf, _head = 1, _tail = 0, _count = 0,
        _capacity = capacity, _template = template, _parent = parent,
    }, Impl) :: any
end

-- ObjectPool — Stack-only fast pool for uniform types
-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type StackPool = {
    Acquire: (self: StackPool) -> Instance,
    Release: (self: StackPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    GetSize: (self: StackPool) -> number,
    Prewarm: (self: StackPool, count: number) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: StackPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = StackPool & {
    _template: Instance,
    _stack: {Instance},
    _parent: Instance?,
    _resetFn: ((Instance) -> ())?,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance
    local inst: Instance
    if #self._stack > 0 then
        inst = table.remove(self._stack)
    else
        inst = self._template:Clone()
        if self._parent then inst.Parent = self._parent end
    end
    if self._resetFn then self._resetFn(inst) end
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if self._resetFn then self._resetFn(instance) end
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
    table.insert(self._stack, instance)
end

function Impl.GetSize(self: Internal): number
    return #self._stack
end

function Impl.Prewarm(self: Internal, count: number)
    for _ = 1, count do
        local inst = self._template:Clone()
        if self._parent then inst.Parent = self._parent end
        if self._resetFn then self._resetFn(inst) end
        if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
            (inst :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
            (inst :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
        end
        table.insert(self._stack, inst)
    end
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, inst in self._stack do inst:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._stack)
end

local StackPool = {}
function StackPool.new(template: Instance, parent: Instance?, resetFn: ((Instance) -> ())?): StackPool
    return setmetatable({
        _template = template, _stack = {}, _parent = parent, _resetFn = resetFn,
    }, Impl) :: any
end

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- PriorityQueue — Binary min-heap
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PriorityQueue<T> = {
    Push: (self: PriorityQueue<T>, value: T, priority: number) -> (),
    Pop: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    Peek: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> T?,
    PeekPriority: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number?,
    GetSize: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> number,
    IsEmpty: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> boolean,
    Clear: (self: PriorityQueue<T>) -> (),
}

type Entry<T> = { value: T, priority: number }
type Internal<T> = PriorityQueue<T> & { _heap: {Entry<T>}, _size: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function siftUp<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, i: number)
    while i > 1 do
        local p = math.floor(i / 2)
        if h[i].priority < h[p].priority then h[i], h[p] = h[p], h[i]; i = p else break end
    end
end

local function siftDown<T>(h: {Entry<T>}, n: number, i: number)
    while true do
        local s, l, r = i, i*2, i*2+1
        if l <= n and h[l].priority < h[s].priority then s = l end
        if r <= n and h[r].priority < h[s].priority then s = r end
        if s == i then break end
        h[i], h[s] = h[s], h[i]; i = s
    end
end

function Impl.Push<T>(self: Internal<T>, value: T, priority: number)
    self._size += 1
    self._heap[self._size] = { value = value, priority = priority }
    siftUp(self._heap, self._size)
end

function Impl.Pop<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end
    local root = self._heap[1]
    self._heap[1] = self._heap[self._size]
    self._heap[self._size] = nil :: any
    self._size -= 1
    if self._size > 0 then siftDown(self._heap, self._size, 1) end
    return root.value
end

function Impl.Peek<T>(self: Internal<T>): T?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].value
end

function Impl.PeekPriority<T>(self: Internal<T>): number?
    if self._size == 0 then return nil end; return self._heap[1].priority
end

function Impl.GetSize<T>(self: Internal<T>): number return self._size end
function Impl.IsEmpty<T>(self: Internal<T>): boolean return self._size == 0 end
function Impl.Clear<T>(self: Internal<T>) table.clear(self._heap); self._size = 0 end

local PriorityQueue = {}
function PriorityQueue.new<T>(): PriorityQueue<T>
    return setmetatable({ _heap = {}, _size = 0 }, Impl) :: any
end
return PriorityQueue

    local empty: DamageResult = { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = 0, killed = false }

-- ObjectPool — Factory-based instance pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type PoolConfig = {
    factory: () -> Instance,
    reset: ((Instance) -> ())?,
    initialSize: number,
    maxSize: number,
    parent: Instance?,
}

export type PooledItem = { instance: Instance, isActive: boolean, id: number }

export type ObjectPool = {
    Acquire: (self: ObjectPool) -> PooledItem?,
    Release: (self: ObjectPool, item: PooledItem) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
    GetActiveCount: (self: ObjectPool) -> number,
    Destroy: (self: ObjectPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = ObjectPool & {
    _config: PoolConfig, _active: {[number]: PooledItem}, _idle: {PooledItem}, _nextId: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function makeItem(self: Internal): PooledItem
    local inst = self._config.factory()
    if self._config.parent then inst.Parent = self._config.parent end
    self._nextId += 1
    return { instance = inst, isActive = false, id = self._nextId }
end

local function resetInst(cfg: PoolConfig, inst: Instance)
    if cfg.reset then cfg.reset(inst); return end
    if inst:IsA("BasePart") then
        local p = inst :: BasePart
        p.Anchored = true; p.CanCollide = false; p.Transparency = 1
        p.CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -10000, 0)
        p.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
    end
end

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): PooledItem?
    local item: PooledItem?
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        item = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif self:GetActiveCount() < self._config.maxSize then
        item = makeItem(self)
    else
        return nil
    end
    item.isActive = true
    self._active[item.id] = item
    return item
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, item: PooledItem)
    if not item.isActive then return end
    item.isActive = false
    self._active[item.id] = nil
    resetInst(self._config, item.instance)
    table.insert(self._idle, item)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap = {}
    for _, item in self._active do table.insert(snap, item) end
    for _, item in snap do self:Release(item) end
end

function Impl.GetActiveCount(self: Internal): number
    local n = 0; for _ in self._active do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, item in self._idle do item.instance:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

local ObjectPool = {}
function ObjectPool.new(config: PoolConfig): ObjectPool
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({
        _config = config, _active = {}, _idle = {}, _nextId = 0,
    }, Impl) :: any
    for _ = 1, config.initialSize do
        local item = makeItem(self)
        resetInst(config, item.instance)
        table.insert(self._idle, item)
    end
    return self :: ObjectPool
end
return ObjectPool

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Callback-dictionary event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
    GetListenerCount: (self: Signal<T...>) -> number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {[(T...) -> ()]: boolean},
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local s = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local cb = (self :: any)._callback
    if s and cb then s._listeners[cb] = nil end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    self._listeners[callback] = true
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _callback = callback,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for cb in self._listeners do task.spawn(cb, ...) end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

function SigImpl.GetListenerCount<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): number
    local n = 0
    for _ in self._listeners do n += 1 end
    return n
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {} }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

    Update: (self: Spring, target: number, dt: number) -> number,

    local disp = self._pos - target
    self._vel += (-self._stiffness * disp - self._damping * self._vel) * dt

end

    local c = config or { stiffness = 100, damping = 10 }
    return setmetatable({ _pos = initial, _vel = 0, _stiffness = c.stiffness, _damping = c.damping }, Impl) :: any
end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")

export type BucketConfig = { maxTokens: number, refillRate: number }
export type RateLimiter = {
    Attempt: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player, cost: number?) -> boolean,
    Peek: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> number,
    Reset: (self: RateLimiter, player: Player) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: RateLimiter) -> (),
}

type Internal = RateLimiter & { _buckets: {[Player]: Bucket}, _config: BucketConfig, _conns: {RBXScriptConnection} }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function refill(b: Bucket, c: BucketConfig)
    local now = os.clock()
    b.tokens = math.min(c.maxTokens, b.tokens + (now - b.lastRefill) * c.refillRate)
    b.lastRefill = now
end

    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return false end
    refill(b, self._config)
    local c = cost or 1
    if b.tokens >= c then b.tokens -= c; return true end
    return false
end

function Impl.Peek(self: Internal, player: Player): number
    local b = self._buckets[player]; if not b then return 0 end
    refill(b, self._config); return b.tokens
end

function Impl.Reset(self: Internal, player: Player)
    local b = self._buckets[player]
    if b then b.tokens = self._config.maxTokens; b.lastRefill = os.clock() end
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._buckets)
end

local RateLimiter = {}
function RateLimiter.new(config: BucketConfig): RateLimiter
    local self: Internal = setmetatable({ _buckets = {}, _config = config, _conns = {} }, Impl) :: any
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end))
    table.insert(self._conns, Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(p) self._buckets[p] = nil end))
    for _, p in Players:GetPlayers() do
        self._buckets[p] = { tokens = config.maxTokens, lastRefill = os.clock() }
    end
    return self :: RateLimiter
end

}

}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Start(self: Internal) if self._state ~= "Running" then self._state = "Running"; self._elapsed = 0 end end
function Impl.Pause(self: Internal) if self._state == "Running" then self._state = "Paused" end end
function Impl.Resume(self: Internal) if self._state == "Paused" then self._state = "Running" end end
function Impl.Stop(self: Internal) self._state = "Idle"; self._elapsed = 0 end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._elapsed = 0; if self._state == "Completed" then self._state = "Idle" end end

function Impl.Update(self: Internal, dt: number)
    if self._state ~= "Running" then return end
    self._elapsed = math.min(self._elapsed + dt, self._duration)
    local p = self:GetProgress()
    for _, cb in self._ticks do task.spawn(cb, self._elapsed, p) end
    if self._elapsed >= self._duration then
        self._state = "Completed"
        for _, cb in self._completes do task.spawn(cb) end
    end

function Impl.GetElapsed(self: Internal): number return self._elapsed end

    end, Connected = true } :: any
end

-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Array-indexed event system with priority
-- ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?) -> Connection,
    Once: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Wait: (self: Signal<T...>) -> T...,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Listener<T...> = {
    callback: (T...) -> (),
    priority: number,
    index: number,
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _listeners: {Listener<T...>},
    _nextIndex: number,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local sig = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    local idx = (self :: any)._index :: number
    for i, listener in sig._listeners do
        if listener.index == idx then
            table.remove(sig._listeners, i)
            return
        end
    end
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

local function insertSorted<T...>(listeners: {Listener<T...>}, entry: Listener<T...>)
    for i = 1, #listeners do
        if entry.priority > listeners[i].priority then
            table.insert(listeners, i, entry)
            return
        end
    end
    table.insert(listeners, entry)
end

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> (), priority: number?): Connection
    self._nextIndex += 1
    local entry: Listener<T...> = {
        callback = callback,
        priority = priority or 0,
        index = self._nextIndex,
    }
    insertSorted(self._listeners, entry)
    return setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _signal = self, _index = entry.index,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
end

function SigImpl.Once<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local conn: Connection
    local function wrapper(...: T...)
        if conn.Connected then conn:Disconnect(); callback(...) end
    end
    conn = self:Connect(wrapper)
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Wait<T...>(self: Internal<T...>): T...
    local thread = coroutine.running()
    self:Once(function(...: T...) task.spawn(thread, ...) end)
    return coroutine.yield()
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    for _, listener in self._listeners do
        task.spawn(listener.callback, ...)
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    table.clear(self._listeners)
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _listeners = {}, _nextIndex = 0 }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Signal — Linked-list event system
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type Connection = {
    Disconnect: (self: Connection) -> (),
    Connected: boolean,
}

type Node<T...> = {
    callback: (T...) -> (),
    next: Node<T...>?,
    prev: Node<T...>?,
    connection: Connection?,
}

export type Signal<T...> = {
    Connect: (self: Signal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()) -> Connection,
    Fire: (self: Signal<T...>, T...) -> (),
    DisconnectAll: (self: Signal<T...>) -> (),
}

type Internal<T...> = Signal<T...> & {
    _head: Node<T...>?,
    _count: number,
}

local ConnImpl = {}
ConnImpl.__index = ConnImpl

function ConnImpl.Disconnect(self: Connection)
    if not self.Connected then return end
    self.Connected = false
    local node = (self :: any)._node :: Node<any>
    if node.prev then node.prev.next = node.next end
    if node.next then node.next.prev = node.prev end
    local sig = (self :: any)._signal :: Internal<any>
    if sig._head == node then sig._head = node.next end
    sig._count -= 1
end

local SigImpl = {}
SigImpl.__index = SigImpl

function SigImpl.Connect<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, callback: (T...) -> ()): Connection
    local node: Node<T...> = {
        callback = callback,
        next = self._head,
        prev = nil,
    }
    if self._head then self._head.prev = node end
    self._head = node
    self._count += 1

    local conn = setmetatable({
        Connected = true, _node = node, _signal = self,
    }, ConnImpl) :: any
    node.connection = conn
    return conn
end

function SigImpl.Fire<T...>(self: Internal<T...>, ...: T...)
    local node = self._head
    while node do
        local next = node.next
        task.spawn(node.callback, ...)
        node = next
    end
end

function SigImpl.DisconnectAll<T...>(self: Internal<T...>)
    local node = self._head
    while node do
        local next = node.next
        node.next = nil
        node.prev = nil
        if node.connection then node.connection.Connected = false end
        node = next
    end
    self._head = nil
    self._count = 0
end

local Signal = {}
function Signal.new<T...>(): Signal<T...>
    return setmetatable({ _head = nil, _count = 0 }, SigImpl) :: any
end
return Signal

-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
-- Timer — Frame-rate independent timer with state machine
-- ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

export type TimerState = "Idle" | "Running" | "Paused" | "Completed"

export type Timer = {
    Start: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Pause: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Resume: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Stop: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Reset: (self: Timer) -> (),
    Update: (self: Timer, dt: number) -> (),
    GetState: (self: Timer) -> TimerState,
    GetElapsed: (self: Timer) -> number,
    GetRemaining: (self: Timer) -> number,
    GetProgress: (self: Timer) -> number,
    OnTick: (self: Timer, cb: (elapsed: number, progress: number) -> ()) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    OnComplete: (self: Timer, cb: () -> ()) -> RBXScriptConnection,
    Destroy: (self: Timer) -> (),
}

type Internal = Timer & {
    _duration: number, _elapsed: number, _state: TimerState,
    _ticks: {(number, number) -> ()}, _completes: {() -> ()},
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Start(self: Internal) if self._state ~= "Running" then self._state = "Running"; self._elapsed = 0 end end
function Impl.Pause(self: Internal) if self._state == "Running" then self._state = "Paused" end end
function Impl.Resume(self: Internal) if self._state == "Paused" then self._state = "Running" end end
function Impl.Stop(self: Internal) self._state = "Idle"; self._elapsed = 0 end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._elapsed = 0; if self._state == "Completed" then self._state = "Idle" end end

function Impl.Update(self: Internal, dt: number)
    if self._state ~= "Running" then return end
    self._elapsed = math.min(self._elapsed + dt, self._duration)
    local p = self:GetProgress()
    for _, cb in self._ticks do task.spawn(cb, self._elapsed, p) end
    if self._elapsed >= self._duration then
        self._state = "Completed"
        for _, cb in self._completes do task.spawn(cb) end
    end
end

function Impl.GetState(self: Internal): TimerState return self._state end
function Impl.GetElapsed(self: Internal): number return self._elapsed end
function Impl.GetRemaining(self: Internal): number return math.max(0, self._duration - self._elapsed) end
function Impl.GetProgress(self: Internal): number
    if self._duration <= 0 then return 1 end
    return math.clamp(self._elapsed / self._duration, 0, 1)
end

function Impl.OnTick(self: Internal, cb: (number, number) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
    table.insert(self._ticks, cb)
    return { Disconnect = function()
        for i, c in self._ticks do if c == cb then table.remove(self._ticks, i); return end end
    end, Connected = true } :: any
end

function Impl.OnComplete(self: Internal, cb: () -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
    table.insert(self._completes, cb)
    return { Disconnect = function()
        for i, c in self._completes do if c == cb then table.remove(self._completes, i); return end end
    end, Connected = true } :: any
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal) table.clear(self._ticks); table.clear(self._completes) end

local Timer = {}
function Timer.new(duration: number): Timer
    assert(duration > 0)
    return setmetatable({
        _duration = duration, _elapsed = 0, _state = "Idle" :: TimerState,
        _ticks = {}, _completes = {},
    }, Impl) :: any
end
return Timer

export type DamageResult = { total: number, shieldDmg: number, healthDmg: number, remaining: number, killed: boolean }
export type HealthData = { hp: number, maxHp: number, shield: number, maxShield: number, invulnUntil: number }
export type HealthSystem = {
    Create: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?) -> (),
    Damage: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> DamageResult,
    Heal: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, amount: number) -> number,
    SetInvulnerable: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player, seconds: number) -> (),
    Get: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> HealthData?,
    IsAlive: (self: HealthSystem, player: Player) -> boolean,
    Destroy: (self: HealthSystem) -> (),
}

Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Create(self: Internal, player: Player, maxHp: number, maxShield: number?)
    self._data[player] = { hp = maxHp, maxHp = maxHp, shield = 0, maxShield = maxShield or 0, invulnUntil = 0 }
end

function Impl.Damage(self: Internal, player: Player, amount: number): DamageResult
    local empty: DamageResult = { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = 0, killed = false }
    local d = self._data[player]
    if not d or d.hp <= 0 or amount <= 0 then
        return d and { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } or empty
    end
    if os.clock() < d.invulnUntil then return { total = 0, shieldDmg = 0, healthDmg = 0, remaining = d.hp, killed = false } end
    local rem, sd = amount, 0
    if d.shield > 0 then sd = math.min(d.shield, rem); d.shield -= sd; rem -= sd end
    local hd = math.min(d.hp, rem); d.hp -= hd
    return { total = sd + hd, shieldDmg = sd, healthDmg = hd, remaining = d.hp, killed = d.hp <= 0 }
end

    local d = self._data[player]; if not d or d.hp <= 0 then return 0 end
    local a = math.min(amount, d.maxHp - d.hp); d.hp += a; return a
end

    local d = self._data[player]; if d then d.invulnUntil = os.clock() + seconds end

    local d = self._data[player]; return d ~= nil and d.hp > 0
end

    for _, c in self._conns do c:Disconnect() end
    table.clear(self._conns); table.clear(self._data)

-- ObjectPool — CollectionService tag-based pool
-- ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")

export type TaggedPool = {
    Acquire: (self: TaggedPool) -> Instance?,
    Release: (self: TaggedPool, instance: Instance) -> (),
    ReleaseAll: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
    GetActive: (self: TaggedPool) -> {Instance},
    Destroy: (self: TaggedPool) -> (),
}

type Internal = TaggedPool & {
    _tag: string,
    _template: Instance,
    _parent: Instance,
    _active: {[Instance]: boolean},
    _idle: {Instance},
    _maxSize: number,
}

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.Acquire(self: Internal): Instance?
    local inst: Instance
    if #self._idle > 0 then
        inst = table.remove(self._idle)
    elseif #self:GetActive() < self._maxSize then
        inst = self._template:Clone()
        CollectionService:AddTag(inst, self._tag)
    else
        return nil
    end
    inst.Parent = self._parent
    self._active[inst] = true
    return inst
end

function Impl.Release(self: Internal, instance: Instance)
    if not self._active[instance] then return end
    self._active[instance] = nil
    if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
        (instance :: BasePart).Transparency = 1
        (instance :: BasePart).CFrame = CFrame.new(0, -5000, 0)
    end
    instance.Parent = nil
    table.insert(self._idle, instance)
end

function Impl.ReleaseAll(self: Internal)
    local snap: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(snap, inst) end
    for _, inst in snap do self:Release(inst) end
end

function Impl.GetActive(self: Internal): {Instance}
    local r: {Instance} = {}
    for inst in self._active do table.insert(r, inst) end
    return r
end

function Impl.Destroy(self: Internal)
    self:ReleaseAll()
    for _, inst in self._idle do inst:Destroy() end
    table.clear(self._idle)
end

local TaggedPool = {}
function TaggedPool.new(tag: string, template: Instance, parent: Instance, maxSize: number): TaggedPool
    return setmetatable({
        _tag = tag, _template = template, _parent = parent,
        _active = {}, _idle = {}, _maxSize = maxSize,
    }, Impl) :: any
end

-- Maid — Inspectable cleanup with task names and types

export type TaskInfo = { name: string, taskType: string }
export type InspectableMaid = {
    GiveTask: (self: InspectableMaid, name: string, task: any) -> (),
    Has: (self: InspectableMaid, name: string) -> boolean,
    Count: (self: InspectableMaid) -> number,
    ListTasks: (self: InspectableMaid) -> {TaskInfo},
    Clean: (self: InspectableMaid) -> (),
    Destroy: (self: InspectableMaid) -> (),
}

type Internal = InspectableMaid & { _tasks: {[string]: any}, _cleaning: boolean }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

function Impl.GiveTask(self: Internal, name: string, task: any)
    if self._tasks[name] then
        local old = self._tasks[name]
        pcall(function()
            if typeof(old) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                if (old :: RBXScriptConnection).Connected then (old :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect() end
            elseif typeof(old) == "Instance" then (old :: Instance):Destroy()
            elseif typeof(old) == "function" then old()
            elseif typeof(old) == "table" and old.Destroy then old:Destroy() end
        end)
    end
    self._tasks[name] = task
end

function Impl.Has(self: Internal, name: string): boolean
    return self._tasks[name] ~= nil
end

function Impl.Count(self: Internal): number
    local n = 0; for _ in self._tasks do n += 1 end; return n
end

function Impl.ListTasks(self: Internal): {TaskInfo}
    local r: {TaskInfo} = {}
    for name, task in self._tasks do
        table.insert(r, { name = name, taskType = typeof(task) })
    end
    return r
end

function Impl.Clean(self: Internal)
    if self._cleaning then return end
    self._cleaning = true
    for _, task in self._tasks do
        pcall(function()
            local t = typeof(task)
            if t == "function" then task()
            elseif t == "RBXScriptConnection" then
                if (task :: RBXScriptConnection).Connected then (task :: RBXScriptConnection):Disconnect() end
            elseif t == "Instance" then (task :: Instance):Destroy()
            elseif t == "table" and task.Destroy then task:Destroy() end
        end)

export type BitBuffer = {
    WriteUInt: (self: BitBuffer, value: number, bits: number) -> (),
    WriteBool: (self: BitBuffer, value: boolean) -> (),

    WriteString: (self: BitBuffer, value: string) -> (),
    ReadUInt: (self: BitBuffer, bits: number) -> number,
    ReadBool: (self: BitBuffer) -> boolean,
    ReadFloat: (self: BitBuffer) -> number,
    ReadString: (self: BitBuffer) -> string,

    Export: (self: BitBuffer) -> buffer,
}

type Internal = BitBuffer & { _buf: buffer, _cursor: number, _size: number }

local Impl = {}
Impl.__index = Impl

local function ensure(self: Internal, bits: number)
    if bits <= self._size * 8 - self._cursor then return end
    local ns = math.max(self._size * 2, math.ceil((self._cursor + bits) / 8))
    local nb = buffer.create(ns); buffer.copy(nb, 0, self._buf, 0, self._size)
    self._buf = nb; self._size = ns
end

function Impl.WriteUInt(self: Internal, value: number, bits: number)
    ensure(self, bits)
    local byte = math.floor(self._cursor / 8)
    local bit = self._cursor % 8
    local mask = bit32.lshift(1, bits) - 1
    local current = buffer.readu32(self._buf, byte)
    current = bit32.band(current, bit32.bnot(bit32.lshift(mask, bit)))
    current = bit32.bor(current, bit32.lshift(bit32.band(value, mask), bit))
    buffer.writeu32(self._buf, byte, current)
    self._cursor += bits
end

function Impl.WriteBool(self: Internal, value: boolean) self:WriteUInt(value and 1 or 0, 1) end

function Impl.WriteFloat(self: Internal, value: number)
    ensure(self, 32); buffer.writef32(self._buf, math.floor(self._cursor / 8), value); self._cursor += 32
end

function Impl.WriteString(self: Internal, value: string)
    self:WriteUInt(#value, 16)
    for i = 1, #value do self:WriteUInt(string.byte(value, i), 8) end
end

function Impl.ReadUInt(self: Internal, bits: number): number
    local byte = math.floor(self._cursor / 8)
    local bit = self._cursor % 8
    self._cursor += bits
    local raw = bit32.rshift(buffer.readu32(self._buf, byte), bit)
    return bit32.band(raw, bit32.lshift(1, bits) - 1)
end

function Impl.ReadBool(self: Internal): boolean return self:ReadUInt(1) == 1 end

function Impl.ReadFloat(self: Internal): number
    local v = buffer.readf32(self._buf, math.floor(self._cursor / 8)); self._cursor += 32; return v
end

function Impl.ReadString(self: Internal): string
    local len = self:ReadUInt(16); local chars = {}
    for i = 1, len do table.insert(chars, string.char(self:ReadUInt(8))) end
    return table.concat(chars)
end

function Impl.GetSize(self: Internal): number return math.ceil(self._cursor / 8) end
function Impl.Reset(self: Internal) self._cursor = 0 end
function Impl.Export(self: Internal): buffer
    local out = buffer.create(self:GetSize()); buffer.copy(out, 0, self._buf, 0, self:GetSize()); return out
end

local BitBuffer = {}
function BitBuffer.new(initialSize: number?): BitBuffer
    local s = initialSize or 256
    return setmetatable({ _buf = buffer.create(s), _cursor = 0, _size = s }, Impl) :: any
end
